## About
Wells Collision Center is an auto body repair shop on W. Fullerton Ave in Chicago. We take cosmetic and major repairs, from dents and paint to frame and uni-body work after an accident.
All repairs are done to the standards set by your vehicle manufacturer. For frame restoration and uni-body repairs we use dimensional measuring and digital imaging systems, and for mechanical problems we use computer diagnostics to find the issue and fix it properly.
Customers rate us 4.6 on Google from 20 reviews. Connie gets mentioned by name, and one reviewer said the paint job came out "better than the factory paint in some spots."

## Services
- Collision Repair: Comprehensive collision work with state-of-the-art equipment. Cosmetic and major repairs accepted.
- Auto Body Repair & Painting: Body repair and refinishing, done with waterborne paint materials.
- Frame & Uni-body Straightening: Frame restoration and uni-body repairs using dimensional measuring and digital imaging systems.
- Paintless Dent Repair (PDR): Dent removal without repainting the panel.
- Auto Mechanical Repairs: Suspension work and mechanical repairs due to an accident, with computer diagnostics to pinpoint the issue and fix it properly.
- Auto Body Repair & Paint Restoration: Paint restored to manufacturer standards using environment friendly waterborne paint materials.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give estimates?
A: Yes. Estimates are free. Stop by the shop on W. Fullerton Ave and we'll look at your car.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on company and fleet vehicles?
A: Yes. One reviewer said we work with Element and fleet management companies and handle mechanical and tommy gate repairs on their box trucks.

Q: What kind of paint do you use?
A: We use waterborne paint materials, which are environment friendly.
